## Summary

req-0044: harness/scripts/npm-resolution-policy.integration.test.ts (~L536, replay expects status 0 gets 1 — on this machine npm refuses --before together with --min-release-age for git deps) and .pi/extensions/pij/core/worktree.test.ts (cleanup ENOTEMPTY) are red on main since 2026-09-01; every PM (gopher, 126, 129) stops on them. Fix the cause where it is a product/test defect; where it is a machine condition, make the test SKIP with a named reason that prints, never a silent pass.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- G1 npm-resolution test: determine whether the replay failure is the test, the script, or the machine npm config; fix or skip-with-reason.
- G2 worktree.test cleanup ENOTEMPTY: fix the teardown (remove in the right order / retry) so it is green on macOS.
- G3 just test on a fresh worktree with symlinked node_modules is green with zero skips unexplained.
